claims.text: Messages arrived at 1,200 per second and two workers processed about 700 per second.
Worker count is fixed and sized for normal traffic.
The sale was not on the capacity calendar, so nobody knew traffic would rise.
During a flash sale the orders topic received about 1,200 messages per second against a normal 300.
Two orders-worker replicas processed about 700 per second, so consumer lag grew to 52,000 and order confirmations were delayed.
A flash sale sent four times the normal order volume, and two workers could not keep up so the orders topic built a backlog of 52,000 messages.
Worker capacity was fixed at normal traffic levels and the sale was not planned for.
